searchText: I beleive <@524738020033691659> opened a PR on hive to enable it via besu config I have not yet. The snap tests have gotten much more prescriptive since last I tested besu's snap implementation with them. We are still failing the majority of tests due to size and count expectations. Once besu pr 6894 merges I will open a hive PR fwiw, the snap specification is much more loose than the hive test expectations enforce. There is latitude for QoS in the spec, but not in the tests: https://github.com/ethereum/devp2p/blob/master/caps/snap.md
